label: MapLibre GL
description: Interactive maps with zero configuration — a MapLibre Map node that renders the free MapLibre demo style out of the box (no access token, no account). Style URL, camera (longitude/latitude/zoom/bearing/pitch) and a Markers array are inputs; camera position, click coordinates and marker clicks are outputs. Bundles MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 (BSD-3-Clause).
